public_rationale: The inspected disclosures show continuing and expanded cloud relationships, including an October 2026 statement that Microsoft remained OpenAI's primary cloud partner. They do not show withdrawal forcing both developers to stop LLM work. They also cannot establish that support will continue indefinitely. With no deadline and no decisive event satisfying the causal rule, the forecast remains open.
limitations: Public agreements do not reveal every financial concession.
Compute purchases, investments, and subsidies are distinct.
The claim supplies no accounting basis for measuring its asserted subsidy.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic will not be able to keep iterating on LLMs indefinitely because Microsoft, Amazon and Google will at some point stop subsidizing their compute.
conditions: because Microsoft, Amazon and Google will stop subsidizing compute

statement.excerpt: I see no situation where OpenAI and Anthropic continue to iterate on Large Language Models in perpetuity, as at some point Microsoft, Amazon and Google decide (or are forced to decide) that cloud compute welfare isn't a business model.

from_speaker: continue to iterate on Large Language Models in perpetuity
at some point Microsoft, Amazon and Google
cloud compute welfare isn't a business model
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading predicts withdrawal of cloud-backed financial or compute support that prevents both named developers from continuing LLM development.
The word because supplies a predicted causal mechanism, not an externally stipulated condition that must already have occurred.
At some point supplies no deadline.
Ordinary paid cloud purchases and distribution agreements do not by themselves establish subsidized compute.
The statement names no financial amount or accounting basis for the supposed subsidy.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish that the relevant cloud backers withdraw subsidized support and that this withdrawal causes both OpenAI and Anthropic to cease continuing LLM development.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive event establishes that the proposed withdrawal cannot cause the predicted cessation, such as durable independence from that support. Continued development or renewed agreements for a finite period alone do not disprove an indefinite forecast.

evidence.excerpt: Microsoft remains OpenAI’s primary cloud partner.
evidence.explanation: OpenAI reported an ongoing Microsoft relationship while announcing Google Cloud distribution. This does not establish the amount of any subsidy or settle eventual withdrawal.

Anthropic described continuing Amazon training support alongside an expanded Google and Broadcom agreement. These arrangements do not establish perpetual support or identify a subsidy on the claim's undefined basis.

The expanded arrangement provides further evidence of continuing cooperation. A finite agreement cannot disprove a forecast about eventual withdrawal, and commercial commitments are not automatically subsidies.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Contracts or disclosures establishing withdrawal of identifiable subsidized support, together with evidence that the withdrawal forces both companies to cease LLM development; alternatively, decisive evidence excluding that dependency.
